title: Seeing Beyond the Natural with a Heavenly Perspective
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner takes us on a journey to experience a heavenly point of view, revealing how God's perspective can change our lives forever. Join Pastor Chris as he walks us through the story of Elisha and the King of Syria, showing us that with God's help, even the impossible becomes possible. Get ready to have your faith ignited and your heart transformed as Pastor Chris brings the Bible to life in a way that will leave you feeling inspired and empowered.
